summary: Backend-only testing of admin user lifecycle endpoints (revoke/restore/delete). Created pytest suite with 11 tests covering: auth guards (401/403), revoke behavior (DB flags, session deletion, whitelist removal), admin protection (400 on self-target), 404 on unknown user, restore flow (whitelist reinstated, revoked_at cleared), full delete (all owned collections wiped + user doc removed + admin list no longer contains user), and full lifecycle create→revoke→restore→revoke→delete. All 11 tests passed. Test user seeded/torn down via pymongo directly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1856 lines — consider splitting into routers (admin, chat, tasks, journal, kb) for maintainability.
admin_delete_user does not delete related uploaded files on disk (if any); only DB collections. Verify no orphan files under any user-specific upload dir.
admin_revoke_user rimuove sessioni ma il body ritorna 'sessions_removed' basato su delete_many.deleted_count — corretto. Nessun bug.

restore endpoint imposta notes='ripristinato dopo revoca' anche se la mail era gia' in whitelist con altre notes — usa $setOnInsert per added_by/added_at ma sovrascrive notes ogni volta; comportamento accettabile ma da documentare.
seed_data_creation: Fixture test_user seeds a fresh user + session + whitelist entry + 1 doc each in tasks/todos/journal_entries/conversations/kb_documents/kb_chunks per test, all cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin lifecycle endpoints verified. If future changes touch server.py admin section (~lines 309-378), rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_users_lifecycle.py -o addopts=''`. Note: pytest.ini uses xdist by default; pass -o addopts='' when running a single file to avoid loadscope errors on isolated runs.
rca of the issue: Original bug: (a) DELETE endpoint missing entirely; (b) revoke had no visible state change nor cascade. Fix (server.py 324-378): revoke now sets revoked_at/revoked_by, deletes user sessions, removes from whitelist. Restore un-sets those and re-adds email to whitelist. DELETE cascade-wipes tasks/todos/journal/conversations/kb_chunks/kb_documents/user_sessions/allowed_emails and finally users. Admin self-protection via email == ADMIN_EMAIL check. All verified end-to-end via DB assertions.
